scope: Use the shared multipart engine in Studio; preserve the draft/reservation over interruptions and page reload; resume only missing parts for a matching file; expose deliberate discard separately from pause.
implementation: Studio now uses lib/video-upload/multipart-uploader.ts through its /api/studio/videos/:id/upload route adapter; the admin route and old localStorage key remain compatible.

An interrupted request does not DELETE the reservation or clear the resume key. Explicit discard aborts only the selected originalId; when active, it first aborts and awaits PUT workers before requesting server cleanup.
Studio stores the associated draft id across reloads and verifies the draft still belongs to the current Studio session before reuse.

Resume identity includes file name, size, mtime and SHA-256 of metadata plus five bounded 32 KiB samples across the file. It avoids reading the full video but is a sampled fingerprint, not a full-file digest.
Studio completion forwards the publish-after-encoding choice through the shared engine.
